description: Read the exact current Chart Studio revision, write one to three concise evidence-bound interpretation points, and place the editable vector chart plus those points into one PPTX slide in a single revision. The result opens the PPTX editor on the changed slide.
name: insert_chart_with_interpretation_into_pptx
